recipe.visualDefinition: A high-tension graphic composition featuring jagged, lightning-like red outlines on a solid black field, paired with a stark vertical sidebar containing ultra-bold, condensed serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Aggressive diagonal movement vs. rigid vertical stability
Organic jagged red forms vs. geometric grey sidebar
High-contrast black background vs. vibrant red and neutral grey
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the right margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Abstract jagged forms occupy 80% of the canvas on the left; a vertical bar occupies the right 20%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical grey bar acts as the structural anchor for the chaotic energy of the red lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the horizontal jagged red lines from left to right, eventually hitting the vertical text block and moving downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background provides deep negative space that makes the red outlines appear to glow or vibrate.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against zero-value black creates maximum visual vibration.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly packed letter spacing to create a solid wall of text

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a grey geometric border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales or weights for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Small equilateral triangles as decorative accents

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast serifs.
Provides the necessary 'Fat Face' weight and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background. Add abstract, jagged red outlines resembling lightning bolts and stylized organic shapes. Add a solid medium-grey vertical bar on the far right edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif text vertically within the grey bar, rotated 90 degrees so the top of the letters faces left.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Are the red lines jagged and lightning-like?
Is the palette strictly black, red, and grey?
Is the font an ultra-condensed modern serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red (from orange-red to deep crimson)
mustRedesign: Any specific band or artist names
Copyright symbols or small legal text in the corners

mustAchieve: Strict geometric layout for the sidebar

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the red lines do not touch the grey sidebar.
Check that the serif font has extreme vertical compression.
Confirm the background is pure black without texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Jagged Red Abstract Outlines] on [Black Background] with a [Vertical Grey Sidebar] containing [Ultra-Condensed Modern Serif Typography].
